recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎完全被造血細胞填滿、脂肪細胞近乎消失，細胞中可見許多深染小圓核成群分布（提示紅血球系聚落）；這是明顯高細胞性骨髓合併紅血球系增生，在此病例為先天性鐵粒母細胞性貧血的無效造血所致。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with near-complete loss of fat spaces
Numerous clusters of small dark round nuclei suggestive of expanded erythroid colonies
Megakaryocytes present and scattered, without clustering
Low power limits cytologic assessment; lineage proportions and ring sideroblasts require aspirate and iron stain
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete effacement of fat spaces between intact bony trabeculae. The hematopoietic tissue contains numerous clusters of small cells with dark round nuclei, suggestive of expanded erythroid colonies, together with scattered megakaryocytes; there is no fibrosis or focal lesion at this magnification. Cytologic detail is limited at this power, so lineage proportions should be confirmed on the aspirate or with immunostains (e.g. E-cadherin, glycophorin). Findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia, which in conjunction with ring sideroblasts on iron stain supports congenital sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Also produces a hypercellular erythroid-hyperplastic marrow; iron stain lacking ring sideroblasts and hemoglobin analysis or hemolysis workup distinguish them.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic, loosely clustered megakaryocytes and JAK2 mutation, rather than isolated erythroid expansion with anemia.
Morphologically similar hypercellular marrow but in older adults with multilineage dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation.
Would show sheets of monotonous blasts replacing marrow rather than maturing erythroid clusters with megakaryocytes.
